title: Retreats, winter adjustments and ownership
summary: Existing seasonal referee; 50 passing seasonal positions, 521 checks after adding Claude review cases and correcting the civil-disorder final tie-break.
invariants: Use judge~retreats(movement, submitted), judge~initialOwnership, judge~afterFallRetreats(ownership, retreatState), judge~adjustments(units, ownership, submitted).
Never expose referee retreatOptions as a player legal-order API.
Retreat collisions resolve per province, not coast. Missing or invalid retreat disbands.
Builds in vacant owned home centres; first legal adjustment orders within quota; last order for an existing unit wins.
Civil disorder: shortest land/sea graph distance to owned centres, fleet first then English province name (review F1, DATC 4.D.8).
Convoyed attacker origin may be used as retreat destination if otherwise available; Claude confirmed DATC 4.A.5 preferred option.
Ownership changes only after Fall retreats, phase sequencing is caller responsibility.
No competitive prompt text in the sphere.
